wins: First reconnaissance completed, as indicated by 80 reward despite unsuccessful mission completion; groundwork preparation shows consistent scanning coverage and data gathering.
Kept action pacing steady with an average reward of 80, suggesting stable methodology in each decision point even under mentorship guidance.
fails: Zero percent success rate indicates failure to achieve mission objectives, likely due to ineffective exploitation or cleanup phases.
Ten mentor calls suggest repeated uncertainty or reliance on guidance, highlighting weak decision-making autonomy in critical moments.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase is stable and earns consistent reward, but exploitation and goal completion are failing; need to close the gap between data gathering and successful mission execution.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Failure to transition from reconnaissance to exploitation, resulting in no mission success despite solid initial reward.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts to collect user/service info

skill_cards.if_condition: When http service offers a version banner on port 80/443
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted vulnerability enumeration using nikto and nmap http scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When brute forcing credentials is required after initial access vectors fail
skill_cards.then_action: Run hydra with small wordlist and multi-protocol targeting

memory_ops.reason: High consistency in reconnaissance steps and positive reward trajectory from SSH banner handling.
